AXIS_1_FINDINGS.claim: A gate bank that grades somebody else's harness, calibrated to zero false positives, producing defects maintainers accept.

corpus.caveat: The upstream corpus is every OSS-Fuzz C/C++ project with a GitHub main_repo. It is not a random sample of fuzzing harnesses in general.

trusted_lifts.caveat: MUST travel with the denominator. The engine declines to opine on 75% of what it lifts.

false_positive_rate.caveat: QuartetFuzz reports 4.8% over EVERYTHING they judged. The denominators are not comparable: we buy precision by abstaining. Across all 1947 lifted harnesses 28.8% carry a blocking violation.

candidates_triaged_by_hand.caveat: The 53 were defects in THIS ENGINE. Fixing them is what made the 2 visible. Most of the work was calibration, not detection.

merged.defect: pix3_fuzzer passes NULL to three functions it means to test; each returns on its !pix guard and had never executed on any input
merged.maintainer: Thank you for finding these errors and providing excellent documentation.

open.defect: bluez fuzz_gobex leaks a GError on every failed decode

upstream_fixes.caveat: QuartetFuzz landed 29 fixes and 3 CVEs. This is 1 merged, 1 open.

AXIS_2_COVERAGE.claim: Mutational plan synthesis reaches OGHarn's +14% median over developer-written harnesses.

value.winning_operator: repeat -- the decompress-stream call run twice

libyaml.result: ZERO viable candidates -- all 8 top-ranked were killed by a smoke test, every one aborting on a valid input
libyaml.why: libyaml is a stateful API guarded by asserts. yaml_parser_set_encoding asserts !parser->encoding; repeating set_input_string or yaml_parser_load re-enters a consumed parser. No header expresses any of it.

measured.caveat: brotli: +0.34 points, +0.40%, positive in 5 of 5 runs, exact Mann-Whitney p = 0.056. libyaml: ZERO viable candidates, all abort on a valid input. Target was +14%.

candidate_space_did_widen.caveat: A CEILING, not coverage. Widening the ceiling did not raise the floor. expat is the control: its bases already reach 76%.

static_gating_is_necessary_but_not_suffi.value: A synthesised candidate that passes every static gate can abort on input 1: yaml_parser_set_encoding asserts !parser->encoding. The pipeline is now static (microseconds) -> smoke test (2s) -> campaign (90s).
static_gating_is_necessary_but_not_suffi.caveat: This qualifies the central bet of the approach and should be reported as a limitation, not omitted.

AXIS_3_NEGATIVE_CAPABILITY.claim: A certificate should state what a harness CANNOT find. Neither competitor emits this.

corpus_scale.headline: 115 of 1374 OSS-Fuzz projects (8.4%) cannot report a leak
corpus_scale.caveat: Every signal is a literal build setting, never an inference. These are BOUNDS, not accusations: a project may disable a detector for good reason.

per_plan_scale.headline: jansson's widest harness calls 3 of 83 exported functions
per_plan_scale.caveat: A floor, not a prediction: unreachable THROUGH THIS PLAN's own calls. The library may reach them internally.

the_bound_as_a_query.caveat: A search that finds nothing bounds how much is left to find. The seam is not rich.

MEASUREMENT_METHODOLOGY.claim: Fixed-time fuzzing benchmarks are far less reproducible than the literature assumes, and the cause is not always the machine.

woff2_n5.caveat: THE KEY RESULT: p = 1.0 on an IDLE host with machine_was_busy false on every record. Spreads of 23.98 and 30.87 points. The cause is `seeds: 0` -- no seed corpus, so each campaign is a random walk. A single sample said 1.31x; another said 0.31x.

pugixml_n5.caveat: Seeded, and therefore steady. The only C++ head-to-head case with a defensible number.

host_contention.caveat: A GUEST VM reports itself idle while its host is saturated, so an in-guest load check gives a false all-clear. Throughput stability is the trustworthy substitute.

GUI_TRACK.claim: An accessibility-tree oracle can distinguish a target REFUSING an input from one that has hung -- a distinction signal-based fuzzers cannot make.

campaign.caveat: 5000 inputs, 0 findings. Acceptance stable at 29% across 12, 400 and 5000 inputs. The campaign is BLIND -- no coverage feedback -- and 3574 of 5000 inputs never reached the decoder.

honest_rating.caveat: The search gained the input it was missing. Whether that finds bugs is unmeasured: 7000 blind inputs across two applications found none, and coverage changes the search rather than the oracle.

applications.caveat: The oracle needs an AT-SPI-exporting toolkit, in practice GTK3+. shotwell accepts corrupt input IDENTICALLY to valid input, so the oracle cannot discriminate there at all -- a target it cannot serve. feh, gpicview, mupdf and xpdf export no accessibility tree.

controlled_comparison.caveat: REPORT PER MUTATION KIND, NOT AS AN AGGREGATE. evince accepts 100% of header, filter, stream_bytes, xref_offset and obj_len mutations and 0% of trailer_drop. The aggregate is a weighted average of near-constants and moves only with the mutator's mix.

coverage_feedback.status: WORKING as of 2026-09-01, previously the track's stated gap
coverage_feedback.value: 25.64% region coverage read back from a running desktop application; the campaign keeps inputs that reach a region nothing else did and mutates from them
coverage_feedback.mechanism: instrumented eog -> open mutated file -> wait for quiescence -> xdotool ctrl+w for a CLEAN EXIT -> .profraw -> llvm-profdata -> llvm-cov export
coverage_feedback.caveat: Coverage is of EOG'S OWN SOURCES, not of the image decoder. Most of what a viewer does with a corrupt PNG happens inside gdk-pixbuf and libpng, which are not instrumented. Application coverage is a loose proxy for depth reached, and the guided-versus-blind comparison has NOT been run, so no claim is made that guidance improves the search.

three_approaches_that_failed.kill_the_process: clang writes the profile in an atexit handler; SIGTERM skips it and leaves a ZERO-BYTE profile indistinguishable from 'covered nothing'.
three_approaches_that_failed.LD_PRELOAD_flush_shim: A SIGUSR1 handler calling __llvm_profile_write_file fails twice -- undefined symbol when linked, NULL from dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT). `nm` shows compiler-rt marks the writer LOCAL, so --export-dynamic cannot export it. Rebuilding eog with --export-dynamic was wasted effort; the nm check should have come first.

NEGATIVE_RESULTS_WORTH_PUBLISHING.result: Corpus-mined API protocol checking finds nothing on this corpus
NEGATIVE_RESULTS_WORTH_PUBLISHING.detail: The technique produces almost no noise on this corpus and also finds nothing. That is a NULL RESULT for corpus-mined protocol checking here, not a tuning problem, and the thresholds were deliberately not adjusted further: continuing until a finding appears would be fitting the instrument to the desired answer.

The effect on brotli is CONSISTENT IN DIRECTION (5/5) and REAL in the sense that the synthesised candidate is never worse. It is also TINY: +0.34 points, +0.40%, against a target of +14%. At n=5 it does not reach significance (p = 0.056). On libyaml the same operators produce nothing usable at all.

NEGATIVE_RESULTS_WORTH_PUBLISHING.result: woff2 cannot measure a coverage ratio at all
NEGATIVE_RESULTS_WORTH_PUBLISHING.detail: p = 1.0 at n=5 on an idle host

NEGATIVE_RESULTS_WORTH_PUBLISHING.result: 5000 blind GUI inputs find nothing in eog

CORRECTIONS_MADE_TO_OUR_OWN_CLAIMS: S1.LEAK was recorded at 57% of trusted lifts; re-measured it was 22%. A census decays and this one ordered the plan a day after it stopped being true.
A fidelity signal detected trust by GREPPING CLI OUTPUT for a phrase, so changing the phrase appeared to make 130 harnesses trustworthy.
Gold was measured by a more generous method than ours.
The audit tool never globbed .cpp and silently dropped ~half the upstream corpus.
The benchmark was blind to machine load; woff2 was later shown to vary just as much on an idle host, so that diagnosis was itself incomplete.
A projected +43% from member-call lifting delivered +5.6%.
An alias-counter 'fix' promising +55 trusted lifts produced 17 FALSE positives against correct harnesses and was reverted.
A synthesis probe reported 'gain -71.79 points' that measured only my own candidate ordering.
Two regexes did not terminate; both were caught by timing the corpus, neither by the test suite.

The eog/evince acceptance comparison was confounded: it varied the mutator and the format together. A PDF-aware mutator was written to control it, and most of the 97% turned out to be a mutator too gentle to be refused.

second_machine.value: Ubuntu 22.04 aarch64 guest, 8 vCPU, disk extended 30G -> 60G
second_machine.caveat: It is a GUEST on the same Mac. It runs benchmarks FASTER and 2.5x more stably than the host (25% vs 64% spread over 7 identical runs), but it cannot serve the purpose PAPERS.md asks of a second machine -- separating campaign variance from HOST effects -- because it is the host. A guest also reports itself idle while its host is saturated, so an in-guest load check gives a false all-clear.
second_machine.how_the_space_was_found: No VM resize was needed. The Ubuntu installer had allocated only 30G of a 61G disk to the logical volume; 30.47G of free extents were already in the volume group. lvextend + resize2fs, ten seconds, no downtime.
